body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Dateline-crossing searches can miss eligible substitute stations, and notifications can claim values were filled even when later validation rejects them.
2 open issues - [Dateline-crossing search bounds miss stations across ±180°](https://github.com/jloosli/mountain-worksheet/pull/304#discussion_r4559072692) · New - [Notifications report substitutions that range validation rejects](https://github.com/jloosli/mountain-worksheet/pull/304#discussion_r4559072723) · New
What changed in this PR Adds automatic weather filling for Non-reporting departure and arrival airports, extending the worksheet’s existing weather-fetch and notification flow. **Changes:** - Uses the nearest eligible station within 100 nm for altimeter settings, with a source Caution. - Uses field-specific model temperature forecasts, with Advisories and failure Warnings. - Adds geometry, fetch, and UI tests and updates the notification documentation. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​utils/​weatherFetch.ts` | Fetches field forecasts and Substitute stations for Non-reporting airports. | | `src/​utils/​weatherDataMapper.ts` | Maps substitute weather into departure and arrival slots. | | `src/​utils/​substituteStation.ts` | Selects nearby stations and builds weather notifications. | | `src/​utils/​positionMath.ts` | Adds distance, bearing, and compass-direction helpers. | | `src/​utils/​aviationWeatherApi.ts` | Adds bounding-box METAR and TAF requests. | | `src/​utils/​aviationWeatherApi.test.ts` | Tests bounding-box requests and failure handling. | | `src/​utils/​airportTimeWeather.ts` | Adds the Substitute-station source type. | | `src/​utils/​airportIdentity.ts` | Supports outcome-specific Non-reporting Advisories. | | `src/​utils/​__tests__/​weatherFetch.test.ts` | Tests Non-reporting weather filling and fallback cases. | | `src/​utils/​__tests__/​substituteStation.test.ts` | Tests station selection and search bounds. | | `src/​utils/​__tests__/​positionMath.test.ts` | Tests distance, bearing, and compass calculations. | | `src/​components/​AppContainer.nonReporting.test.tsx` | Tests filled values and Caution provenance in the UI. | | `GLOSSARY.md` | Clarifies altimeter Cautions and model-temperature Advisories. | | `docs/​adr/​0003-weather-for-non-reporting-airports.md` | Records the implemented weather-source and notification decisions. |
Review effort: Balanced

### 🔵 Needs a closer look The outcome Advisory remains after manual weather entry, leaving stale instructions or source claims that should be updated or retired and covered by a regression test. **No open issues** 🎉
1 previously missed issue In code that hasn't changed since last review
Retire stale forecast advisory details after manual weather entry `src/​utils/​substituteStation.ts:255` After a failed model forecast, manually entering the temperature clears its Warning but leaves this Advisory saying to enter it manually. The outcome detail is attached to `airport[slot]`, so `fetchNotifications` in `weatherSession.ts` retains it while the airport is unchanged—even when temperature or altimeter edits invalidate its instructions or source claims. Keep the Non-reporting identity Advisory, but derive or retire its outcome details against the corresponding weather values, and add a regression test for manual entry.
2 resolved since last review - [Notifications report substitutions that range validation rejects](https://github.com/jloosli/mountain-worksheet/pull/304#discussion_r4559072723) - [Dateline-crossing search bounds miss stations across ±180°](https://github.com/jloosli/mountain-worksheet/pull/304#discussion_r4559072692)
Review effort: Balanced
